lines.en: label otohadorm10p2:
Niki once again offers to call a driver from her agency to pick us up, but Otoha remains adamant about not wanting to impose and decides to just charter her own ride off of a ride sharing app.
lines.zh: Niki 又一次提出从她的经纪公司叫个司机来接我们，但 Otoha 坚持不想给人添麻烦，决定自己在网约车软件上叫一辆。

lines.en: She asks me to chip in, which is mildly infuriating because it means she’s fine with imposing on {i}me-{/i}
lines.zh: 她让我也出一份钱，这让我有点上火——因为这说明她对给{i}我{/i}添麻烦倒是毫无心理负担——

lines.en: But I guess it makes sense because she probably also wants to sleep with Niki more than she wants to sleep with me right now. Which I don’t blame her for.
lines.zh: 不过想想也合理，因为她这会儿大概更想跟 Niki 上床，而不是跟我。这我不怪她。

lines.en: Either way, I do my good deed for the week in an attempt to tip the scales by paying for the entire ride.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我这周的好事算是做了：整趟车费我全掏，试图把天平掰回来一点。

lines.en: Now, Niki and I should be on equal footing when it comes to seducing our shared student.
lines.zh: 这样一来，在勾引我们共同的学生这件事上，Niki 和我应该又回到同一起跑线了。

lines.en: Eventually, we make it to the restaurant and head inside.
lines.zh: 最后我们到了餐厅，走了进去。

lines.en: Otoha informs the staff that we’re here to meet someone and, as if they're expecting us, they lead us over to Niki’s table, which has already been sectioned off from the others.
lines.zh: Otoha 告诉店员我们是来见人的，而他们像是早就在等我们似的，把我们领到 Niki 那张桌前——那张桌子已经和其他座位隔开了。

lines.en: Niki is obviously no stranger to flexing her “famous” muscle, but she normally doesn’t do it like this.
lines.zh: Niki 显然对炫耀自己「名人」的身份毫不陌生，但她平时不太会这么干。

lines.en: I guess it’s a little different impressing [young]girls than it is impressing me, though.
lines.zh: 不过，打动 [young] 女孩大概和打动我是两回事。

lines.en: And I’m not about to argue with additional privacy when that sort of thing has been becoming harder and harder to come by lately.
lines.zh: 再说，这种清静最近越来越难得了，我也懒得跟它过不去。

lines.en: Anyway, Otoha and I take a seat at opposite sides of the table, and the wait for our final dinner guest begins...
lines.zh: 总之，Otoha 和我在桌子的两侧坐下，等待今晚最后一位客人……

lines.en: scene otohadinner1
: So, uhh...Rin said she’s on her way.
lines.zh: : 那个，呃……Rin 说她在路上了。

lines.en: : She also says that she is sorry in advance for, and this is a direct quote, “The overwhelming scent of vanilla bean [[COPYRIGHTED FROZEN BEVERAGE]s.”
lines.zh: : 她还让我提前替她道个歉——原话是——「扑面而来的香草豆 [[COPYRIGHTED FROZEN BEVERAGE] 味儿。」

lines.en: : That bitch. Why would she not offer to bring us any? I love [[COPYRIGHTED FROZEN BEVERAGE]s.
lines.zh: : 这混蛋。她怎么也不说给我们带几杯？我最爱 [[COPYRIGHTED FROZEN BEVERAGE] 了。

lines.en: : Is anyone else having a hard time comprehending the ends of sentences right now? Or is it just me?
lines.zh: : 只有我一个人现在听不懂句子的结尾吗？还是别人也听不懂？

lines.en: scene otohadinner2
: So...have you two, like...been here before? Because I’m starting to think this might be a little out of my price range.
lines.zh: : 那个……你们俩，嗯……以前来过这儿吗？我开始觉得这地方好像有点超出我的消费水平了。

lines.en: : Oh, don’t worry about that. I wouldn’t make you pay for your own dinner.
lines.zh: : 哦，别担心这个。我不会让你自己付饭钱的。

lines.en: : You make {i}me{/i} pay for my own dinner almost every time we go out.
lines.zh: : 可我们每次出去，你几乎都让我{i}自己{/i}付饭钱。

lines.en: : Sometimes, you even make me pay for you.
lines.zh: : 有时候，你甚至还让我替你付。

lines.en: scene otohadinner3
: Yeah. And?
lines.zh: : 对啊。那又怎样？

lines.en: : I just don’t think it’s very fair that Otoha gets treated better than me when I have brought you a much greater deal of joy in your life.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得不太公平——我给你的人生带来的快乐可比 Otoha 多得多，她凭什么待遇比我好。

lines.en: : You bring me nothing but anger and fury.
lines.zh: : 你给我带来的只有愤怒和火大。

lines.en: scene otohadinner4
: But we’re not here to talk about you. We’re here to talk about Otoha.
lines.zh: : 不过我们今晚不是来聊你的。是来聊 Otoha 的。

lines.en: : Wait, we are? I thought this was just, like...a double date thing. Why do we have to talk about me?
lines.zh: : 等等，是吗？我还以为这只是……嗯……一次四人约会。为什么非要聊我啊？

lines.en: : You just don’t normally bring your girlfriend around me. Rin, right? Is she the one you were with at the diner during your...dorm war whatever?
lines.zh: : 你平时不怎么把你女朋友带到我面前嘛。叫 Rin，对吧？就是在那个小餐馆里跟你一起的那个，你们闹……宿舍大战什么的？

lines.en: : Yeah...and the reason I don’t bring her around you is because I only see you one day a week.
lines.zh: : 对……我不把她带到你面前，是因为我一周才能见你一次。

lines.en: : That didn’t stop you from bringing the man who simultaneously ruined my life and made it better all at once, though.
lines.zh: : 可这也没妨碍你把一个同时毁了我的人生、又让它变好的人带来见我。

lines.en: scene otohadinner5
: I mean...he kind of just came along. It’s not like I made the conscious decision to bring him there.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……他算是自己跟来的。我又不是特意决定把他带去的。

lines.en: : We should do that more often. That basement is surprisingly homey for one of the most suspicious places I’ve ever set foot in.
lines.zh: : 我们应该多来几次。那间地下室可是我踏足过的最可疑的地方之一，却意外地挺有家的感觉。

lines.en: : I can’t tell if that's a compliment or not.
lines.zh: : 我不知道这算不算夸奖。

lines.en: : I guess it's closer to being a compliment than {i}not{/i} being a compliment.
lines.zh: : 大概比起{i}不是{/i}夸奖，还是更接近夸奖一点。

lines.en: : Your face is closer to being fucking stupid than {i}not{/i} being stupid.
lines.zh: : 你的脸比起{i}不{/i}蠢，还是更接近蠢得要死一点。

lines.en: : So, like...are you two getting back together or something?
lines.zh: : 那，嗯……你们俩是要复合还是怎么着？

lines.en: : Yeah, {i}are{/i} we getting back together or something? Answer her question.
lines.zh: : 对啊，我们{i}是{/i}要复合还是怎么着？回答她的问题。

lines.en: : I’m just here for the free food and cute girls.
lines.zh: : 我来只是为了免费的食物和可爱的姑娘。

lines.en: : {i}Girl.{/i} You mean me. It’s rude to call the other couple cute when you’re on a double date unless you’re trying to swing.
lines.zh: : {i}姑娘。{/i} 你说的是我。四人约会的时候夸另一对可爱是很失礼的——除非你是想换伴。

lines.en: scene otohadinner6
: Well, it’s...still kind of a single date until Rin gets here. So if you two want to keep flirting or whatever, don’t mind me.
lines.zh: : 嗯……在 Rin 来之前，这还算是场单人约会。所以你们俩要是想继续调情什么的，不用管我。

lines.en: : I’ll just chill until I’m actually allowed to, like...cooperate and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我就先歇着，等到我真的可以……嗯……配合你们的时候再说。

lines.en: scene otohadinner7
: Hmm...you’ve never actually been on a double date before, have you?
lines.zh: : 嗯……你其实从来没参加过四人约会吧？

lines.en: : Have {i}you{/i}?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}参加过吗？

lines.en: : Shut the fuck up.
lines.zh: : 给我闭嘴。

lines.en: : I mean...no? This is the first relationship I’ve ever had. And I {i}definitely{/i} can’t say I envisioned my first double date also involving my teacher and a famous musician.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……没有吧？这是我谈的第一场恋爱。而且我{i}绝对{/i}没想过，我的第一次四人约会还会有我的老师和一个知名音乐人。

lines.en: : Are you nervous? Is that what’s going on? Because you seem less...Otoha than usual.
lines.zh: : 你紧张吗？是不是因为这个？因为你看起来比平时……不太 Otoha。

lines.en: : I can assure you that I am the regular amount of Otoha.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，我的 Otoha 含量是正常值。

lines.en: : I guess I’ll hold off on passing final judgement until Rin shows up.
lines.zh: : 那我等 Rin 来了再下最终结论吧。

lines.en: : Why am I being judged at all? What does my aptitude for conversing at a strange double date have to do with literally anything?
lines.zh: : 我到底为什么要被评判啊？我在一场奇怪的四人约会上聊天的水平，跟任何事到底有什么关系？

lines.en: scene otohadinner8
: You’d be surprised.
lines.zh: : 你会惊讶的。

lines.en: : By {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 惊讶于{i}什么？{/i}

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure Niki is just trying to sound like she knows what she’s talking about when it comes to relationships.
lines.zh: : 我很确定 Niki 只是想显得自己很懂感情那一套。

lines.en: : And I’m pretty sure that I may {i}accidentally{/i} walk out of this restaurant and leave you to pay for everything if you don’t humor me right now.
lines.zh: : 而我也很确定，你要是现在不顺着我说，我可能会{i}不小心{/i}走出这家餐厅，留你一个人付全部的钱。

lines.en: : So much for tonight being about Otoha.
lines.zh: : 说好的今晚是围绕 Otoha 呢。

lines.en: scene otohadinner9
: You fucking-
lines.zh: : 你他——

lines.en: : Hey! I’m here! Sorry for being so late!
lines.zh: : 嘿！我到了！抱歉迟到了这么久！

lines.en: scene otohadinner10
: Oh my God, hi! You must be Rin!
lines.zh: : 我的天，你好！你一定就是 Rin！

lines.en: : Finish your sentence, Niki.
lines.zh: : 把话说完，Niki。

lines.en: : {i}Die in a fire.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}去死吧。{/i}

lines.en: : It’s so nice to meet you! Otoha talks about you literally {i}all{/i} the time.
lines.zh: : 很高兴认识你！Otoha 真的是{i}无时无刻{/i}都在说你。

lines.en: : I do? Oh...Oh, yeah! I definitely do. That’s a...true thing she just said.
lines.zh: : 我有吗？哦……哦，对！我当然有。她刚才说的……是实话。

lines.en: scene black
Rin shoves her bag under the table and takes a seat beside Otoha.
lines.zh: Rin 把包塞到桌子底下，在 Otoha 旁边坐下。

lines.en: The overwhelming scent of whatever vanilla thing was alluded to earlier is immediately apparent, but not necessarily unpleasant in any sense.
lines.zh: 先前暗示过的那股浓烈的香草味立刻扑面而来，但倒也说不上有多难闻。

lines.en: I wonder if Otoha is sick of it by now.
lines.zh: 我猜 Otoha 现在是不是已经闻腻了。

lines.en: I wonder if that’s something you can get sick {i}of.{/i}
lines.zh: 我也在想，这种东西到底能不能让人{i}腻{/i}。

lines.en: And I wonder how the rest of tonight is going to go now that what I view as a fracturing relationship is seated straight across from one that’s already finished breaking.
lines.zh: 我还想知道，接下来这一晚会怎么走——毕竟我觉得正在裂开的那段关系，此刻正坐在一段已经彻底碎掉的关系对面。

lines.en: scene otohadinner11
: Hey. I’d give you a hug and stuff, but I’m not really sure what the rules of double dates are or if you’d even be cool with that.
lines.zh: : 嘿。我倒是想抱你一下什么的，但我不太清楚四人约会的规矩，也不知道你介不介意。

lines.en: : So I’ll just say I’m hugging you in my mind right now and we can ignore how much I actually want to hug you.
lines.zh: : 所以我就说，我现在在脑子里抱你了；至于我有多想真的抱你，我们就当没看见吧。

lines.en: Well, I guess Rin really is over the whole thing with Otoha’s parents.
lines.zh: 看来 Rin 是真的从 Otoha 父母那件事里走出来了。

lines.en: Or just that she’s so in love that no amount of uncertainty could detract from her limited inhibition that causes her to constantly speak before thinking.
lines.zh: 又或者她爱得太深，再多的不安也压不住她那点少得可怜的顾忌——所以她总是想都不想就开口。

lines.en: scene otohadinner12
: That aside, though...holy shit. I’m on a date with Niki Nakayama.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来……卧槽。我在和 Niki Nakayama 约会。

lines.en: : Well, not {i}with{/i} Niki Nakayama. But you’re here. And I’m here. At the date.
lines.zh: : 嗯，也不算{i}和{/i} Niki Nakayama 约会。不过你在这儿。我也在这儿。在这场约会上。

lines.en: : We’re at the same place at the same time. Which is a date. But not the same date.
lines.zh: : 我们在同一时间出现在同一地点。这就是约会。但又不是同一场约会。

lines.en: : Wow.
: Wow.
scene otohadinner13
: So that’s Rin. Glad we’re all acquainted now.
lines.zh: : 这就是 Rin 了。很高兴大家都互相认识了吧。

lines.en: : Hahah...sorry. I’m not around famous people all that often...
lines.zh: : 哈哈……抱歉。我不太常和名人打交道……

lines.en: : {i}I{/i}, for one, see no issue at all with how you greeted me, Rin.
lines.zh: : 至少{i}我{/i}觉得你打招呼的方式完全没问题，Rin。

lines.en: : In fact, I think your reaction to me was completely within the bounds of how I expect {i}all{/i} people to react when meeting me.
lines.zh: : 事实上，你见到我时的反应，完全在我预期{i}所有{/i}人见到我时的反应之内。

lines.en: : That’s because you’re a narcissist.
lines.zh: : 那是因为你是个自恋狂。

lines.en: : Oh. And {i}you’re{/i} not? Please. I don’t want to hear it.
lines.zh: : 哦。那{i}你{/i}就不是了？得了吧。我不想听。

lines.en: scene otohadinner14
: Everyone already knows the real me. How many people know the real you, though?
lines.zh: : 真正的我，大家都知道了。可又有多少人认识真正的你呢？

lines.en: : What does that have to do with narcissism? What are you even trying to argue here?
lines.zh: : 这跟自恋有什么关系？你到底在争什么？

lines.en: : You know what, you really are paying for your own dinner. I was just joking when I talked about that before, but now I’m serious.
lines.zh: : 行吧，你的饭钱你真的自己付。之前说那话我是开玩笑的，但现在我是认真的。

lines.en: : Have they been like this the entire time?
lines.zh: : 她们一直都是这样吗？

lines.en: : Yuuuuuuuup.
scene otohadinner15
: Then I’m really sorry for not getting here earlier. I tried, but it was like, {i}crazy{/i} busy.
lines.zh: : 那我真的很抱歉没早点来。我尽力了，但店里{i}超级{/i}忙。

lines.en: : You get one warm-ish day and people just frickin’ show up in flocks for [[COPYRIGHTED FROZEN BEVERAGE]s.
lines.zh: : 天气只要稍微暖和一点，人们就他妈成群结队地来买 [[COPYRIGHTED FROZEN BEVERAGE]。

lines.en: : It’s fine. Just try not to leave me alone with other couples anymore because I have learned tonight that I definitely do not like it.
lines.zh: : 没事。只是以后别再把我一个人丢给别的情侣了——今晚我算是明白了，我绝对不喜欢这样。

lines.en: : I’ll do my best.
lines.zh: : 我尽量。

lines.en: : I missed you.
lines.zh: : 我想你了。

lines.en: : I missed you too, Rin.
lines.zh: : 我也想你，Rin。

lines.en: scene black
scene otohadinner16
: Right?! Like, it should be up to {i}me{/i} if I want to take my music in a different direction! Not the stupid agency!
lines.zh: : 对吧？！我想把自己的音乐带向别的方向，那该由{i}我{/i}说了算！而不是那家破经纪公司！

lines.en: : People love {i}Niki.{/i} They don’t give {i}any amount of shits{/i} about 567 Productions.
lines.zh: : 人们爱的是{i}Niki{/i}。他们{i}根本一点都{/i}不在乎 567 Productions。

lines.en: : But nope! The money machine must churn! And I’m the only one fucking strong enough to push down the lever thingy!
lines.zh: : 可是不行！印钞机必须转起来！而我是他妈唯一有力气把那根拉杆压下去的人！

lines.en: : It’s not fair! Like, you’re clearly {i}miles{/i} ahead of pretty much everyone else in your industry. And the fact that your talent is being suppressed like this is just...I can’t even.
lines.zh: : 太不公平了！你明明比你那个行业里几乎所有人都{i}强出一大截{/i}。你的才华被这样压着，简直……我无话可说。

lines.en: scene otohadinner17
: Otoha. I like this girl. You can bring her around whenever you want.
lines.zh: : Otoha。我喜欢这姑娘。你想什么时候带她来都行。

lines.en: scene otohadinner18
: Wouldn’t that...you know...kind of get in the way of my singing lessons? I don’t really think I'll be able to focus if Rin is there.
lines.zh: : 那样……你知道的……会不会有点妨碍我上声乐课？Rin 在场的话，我觉得自己大概没法集中。

lines.en: : Do you...like giving lessons, Niki? Like, it must be some sort of passion project, right? Because I can’t imagine you’re making a lot of money off of them.
lines.zh: : Niki，你……喜欢教课吗？我是说，这应该是某种出于热爱的事吧？因为我没法想象你能靠这个赚很多钱。

lines.en: : It’s 100%% a passion thing. Otoha’s got serious potential and I want to help her bring that out.
lines.zh: : 这 100%% 是出于热爱。Otoha 很有潜力，我想帮她把那份潜力挖出来。

lines.en: scene otohadinner19
: Right?! She’s absolutely amazing! I can definitely see her becoming like, mega famous one day if she keeps it up.
lines.zh: : 对吧？！她真的超厉害！要是她继续下去，我完全能想象她有一天会变得超级有名。

lines.en: : That’s why I offered to start paying for her lessons if her parents decided to stop. I really think she has what it takes.
lines.zh: : 所以我才提出，如果她父母不肯付了，我就开始替她出学费。我是真的觉得她有这个本事。

lines.en: scene otohadinner20
: Rin, come on. Don’t bring them up right-
lines.zh: : Rin，别说了。别提他们——

lines.en: : Wait, are they seriously considering taking you out of vocal lessons? Why?
lines.zh: : 等等，他们真的在考虑不让你上声乐课了？为什么？

lines.en: : Great. I guess we’re talking about this now.
lines.zh: : 好极了。看来我们现在要聊这个了。

lines.en: : Of course we’re talking about this now. This is something you should have told me about immediately.
lines.zh: : 我们当然要现在聊这个。这种事你本该第一时间就告诉我。

lines.en: : What’s the issue? Why would they do something like that?
lines.zh: : 到底怎么回事？他们为什么要这么做？

lines.en: : Oh...I don’t really think Otoha wants me to keep going. I already said too much.
lines.zh: : 哦……我觉得 Otoha 其实不太想让我继续说下去。我已经说得太多了。

lines.en: : Thank you, Rin.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你了，Rin。

lines.en: : No, if they’re seriously considering this, {i}I{/i} need to speak with them. Because I can not allow that to happen.
lines.zh: : 不，如果他们真的在考虑这件事，那{i}我{/i}必须和他们谈谈。因为我绝不能让这种事发生。

lines.en: : Niki-
lines.zh: : Niki——

lines.en: : Is it a money thing? Because I will literally do this on spec. That’s how much faith I have in you, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 是钱的问题吗？如果是的话，我真的可以先不收一分钱。我对你的信心就有这么大，Otoha。

lines.en: scene otohadinner21
: On spec? So like...you wouldn’t get paid until after Otoha starts making money off of her singing?
lines.zh: : 先不收钱？意思是……你要等 Otoha 靠唱歌赚到钱以后才拿报酬？

lines.en: : Yeah. And even then, I wouldn’t really care. I’d be doing a disservice to the music industry if I didn’t help her hone that talent of hers.
lines.zh: : 对。而且到那时候我也无所谓。我要是不帮她打磨这份才华，那才是对音乐圈的辜负。

lines.en: : I will literally give Otoha lessons for free if her parents are going to be fucking cunts about this.
lines.zh: : 要是她父母在这件事上非要当混蛋，我真的可以免费给 Otoha 上课。

lines.en: scene otohadinner22
: For real?! That’s amazing! And so nice!
lines.zh: : 真的吗？！太棒了！人也太好了吧！

lines.en: scene otohadinner23
: Did you hear that, Otoha?!
lines.zh: : 你听到了吗，Otoha？！

lines.en: : You don’t have to worry about money anymore! Niki’s fine with giving you lessons for free!
lines.zh: : 你再也不用为钱发愁了！Niki 愿意免费给你上课！

lines.en: : Which means we don’t have to worry about-
lines.zh: : 也就是说我们再也不用担心——

lines.en: scene otohadinner24
: We...don't...
lines.zh: : 我们再也不……

lines.en: : Otoha?
lines.zh: : Otoha？

lines.en: : Why aren’t you freaking out? This is great news.
lines.zh: : 你怎么一点都不激动？这可是天大的好消息啊。

lines.en: : Isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 不是吗？

lines.en: : Oh...no.
lines.zh: : 哦……糟了。

lines.en: Niki instinctively reaches for the sleeve of my shirt, knowing that, somehow, she managed to do something wrong by simply being nice.
lines.zh: Niki 下意识地伸手抓住我的袖子——她知道，自己只是出于好意，却不知怎么又做错了。

lines.en: And, in a moment of rare self-gratitude, I feel a little better about never going out of my way for anyone.
lines.zh: 而在这个难得的自我感激瞬间，我为自己从不特意为任何人付出而感到好受了一点。

lines.en: Peoples’ true colors come out when you show them too much kindness.
lines.zh: 你给别人太多善意时，他们的本色就会露出来。

lines.en: And, it could just be the light-
lines.zh: 也许只是灯光的关系——

lines.en: But Otoha looks very colorful right now.
lines.zh: 但 Otoha 此刻看起来色彩斑斓得很。

lines.en: scene otohadinner25

lines.zh: : 这件事……

lines.en: : It wasn’t just about the money, was it?...
lines.zh: : 不只是钱的问题，对吧？……

lines.en: None of us say anything, and it becomes clear that Rin isn’t going to let silence answer this question either.
lines.zh: 我们谁都没说话，而 Rin 显然也不打算让沉默来代替回答。

lines.en: We just sit and wait for Otoha to do something.
lines.zh: 我们只是坐着，等 Otoha 做出点什么。

lines.en: scene otohadinner26
scene otohadinner27
: Okay.
: Okay...
: Rin-
lines.zh: : Rin——

lines.en: scene otohadinner28
: Thanks for coming tonight. I was really looking forward to it.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你今晚过来。我真的很期待。

lines.en: : I’m sorry I couldn’t stay any longer.
lines.zh: : 抱歉我不能再待下去了。

lines.en: : Wait...Rin. Hold on.
lines.zh: : 等等……Rin。等一下。

lines.en: scene otohadinner29
: I’ll call you later, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我回头给你打电话，Sensei。

lines.en: : Hey! I said hold on!
lines.zh: : 嘿！我说了等一下！

lines.en: : For what?
lines.zh: : 等什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : Well, let me know when you do.
lines.zh: : 那等你知道了再告诉我。

lines.en: scene black
Rin grabs her bag from underneath the table.
lines.zh: Rin 从桌子底下抓起自己的包。

lines.en: The scent of vanilla bean vanishes with her.
lines.zh: 那股香草豆的气味随她一起消失了。

lines.en: scene otohadinner30
: What the fuck are you waiting for?! Chase after her!
lines.zh: : 你他妈还等什么？！追出去啊！

lines.en: : Don’t tell {i}me,{/i} idiot! Tell her! She’s the one who needs to hear it!
lines.zh: : 别跟{i}我{/i}说，蠢货！跟她说！需要听到这句话的是她！

lines.en: : Okay. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 好。行。

lines.en: : I’ll be right back!
lines.zh: : 我马上回来！

lines.en: scene otohadinner31
Otoha runs out of the restaurant, nearly knocking over the waiter who I assume is carrying everything we ordered.
lines.zh: Otoha 冲出餐厅，差点撞翻那个我猜正端着我们点的所有菜的服务员。

lines.en: I breathe a sigh of relief for the expensive dinner Niki is about to buy for me-
lines.zh: 我为 Niki 即将替我付账的那顿昂贵晚餐松了口气——

lines.en: And another sigh for a girl who keeps gluing her heart to the wrong things.
lines.zh: 又为一个总是把心粘在错误东西上的女孩叹了口气。

lines.en: : Girls can be so fucking dumb sometimes. Just {i}talk.{/i} It’s that easy.
lines.zh: : 女生有时候真是蠢得要命。{i}开口说话{/i}就行了。就这么简单。

lines.en: : Some things aren’t easy to talk about, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概有些事就是不好开口吧。

lines.en: : Ugh. Whatever. Guess it’ll have to just be a single date.
lines.zh: : 唉。算了。看来今晚只能算是个单人约会了。

lines.en: : Uh-oh. What happens if we fall in love?
lines.zh: : 哎呀。要是我们爱上彼此了怎么办？

lines.en: : Not funny.
lines.zh: : 不好笑。

lines.en: scene black
scene otohadinner32
: Yo! Hold on!
lines.zh: : 喂！等等！

lines.en: : Oh, you followed me out. What a surprise.
lines.zh: : 哦，你还追出来了。真意外。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, okay?!
lines.zh: : 对不起，行了吧？！

lines.en: : It's just...this is all still new to me!
lines.zh: : 只是……这一切对我来说还很新鲜！

lines.en: : You mean dating in general? Or dating a girl?
lines.zh: : 你是说约会本身？还是和女生约会？

lines.en: scene otohadinner33
: Both...
lines.zh: : 都是……

lines.en: : Would it be easier to tell my parents about us if you were a boy? Yes. Absolutely.
lines.zh: : 如果你是个男生，我跟我父母说我们的事会更容易吗？会。绝对的。

lines.en: : What’s normal for {i}us{/i} isn’t what’s normal for everyone else. But that doesn’t mean I don’t {i}like{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 对{i}我们{/i}来说正常的事，对别人来说未必正常。但这不代表我{i}不喜欢{/i}。

lines.en: : You think I would have willingly hung out with our teacher all day if we {i}weren’t{/i} going on this double date thing tonight?
lines.zh: : 你以为，如果今晚{i}不是{/i}要参加这场四人约会，我会心甘情愿跟我们老师逛一整天吗？

lines.en: : I know you’d find it {i}easier{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我知道你会觉得那样{i}更轻松。{/i}

lines.en: scene otohadinner34
: That’s not what I meant...
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思……

lines.en: : I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : My parents aren’t like yours. {i}Most{/i} parents aren’t like yours.
lines.zh: : 我的父母跟你的不一样。{i}大多数{/i}父母都跟你的不一样。

lines.en: : And we can’t just pretend they are because that’s more...convenient for us.
lines.zh: : 而我们也不能因为那样对我们更……方便，就假装他们一样。

lines.en: : Are you embarrassed to be dating a girl, Otoha?
lines.zh: : 你是在为和女生交往感到丢人吗，Otoha？

lines.en: : That’s not-
lines.zh: : 那不是——

lines.en: : Just give me a yes or no answer, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 只要回答我是或不是，Otoha。

lines.en: scene otohadinner35
: Yes.
: I am.
lines.zh: : 我是在觉得丢人。

lines.en: : I’m so fucking stupid.
lines.zh: : 我真他妈蠢。

lines.en: : You’re not, Rin...
lines.zh: : 你不蠢，Rin……

lines.en: : You didn’t do anything wrong.
lines.zh: : 你没做错任何事。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...
lines.zh: : 是吗，嗯……

lines.en: : That’s not entirely true either.
lines.zh: : 这话也不完全对。

lines.en: scene otohadinner36
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : What is that supposed to mean?
lines.zh: : 你这话什么意思？

lines.en: : It {i}means{/i} that you’re not the only one who’s been hiding something for the sake of not making the other person uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 意思{i}是{/i}，为了不让对方难堪而藏着什么的人，不只有你一个。

lines.en: : What...have you been hiding?
lines.zh: : 你……藏了什么？

lines.en: : Take my shirt off and you’ll find out.
lines.zh: : 把我的衬衫脱了你就知道了。

lines.en: : Unless you’re too embarrassed to undress your girlfriend, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然，除非你不好意思脱自己女朋友的衣服。

lines.en: scene otohadinner37
: Rin...
lines.zh: : Rin……

lines.en: : For real?...
lines.zh: : 真的吗？……

lines.en: : You came clean about your thing, so it’s only fair that I come clean about mine.
lines.zh: : 你把自己的事坦白了，那我也该坦白我的，这样才公平。

lines.en: : Stop walking.
lines.zh: : 别走了。

lines.en: : I don’t want to look at you.
lines.zh: : 我不想看你。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because you’re too cute and it’s annoying and I won’t be able to be mad anymore.
lines.zh: : 因为你太可爱了，烦死了，那样我就生不起气了。

lines.en: : Stop walking, Rin.
lines.zh: : 别走了，Rin。

lines.en: : Fine. But we aren’t done fighting yet.
lines.zh: : 行吧。不过我们还没吵完呢。

lines.en: scene black
scene otohadinner38
: Why didn’t you tell me?...
lines.zh: : 你为什么不告诉我？……

lines.en: : Why didn’t you tell {i}me{/i} that you haven’t fully accepted your sexuality yet?
lines.zh: : 你为什么不告诉{i}我{/i}，你还没有完全接受自己的性取向？

lines.en: : Unless you’re treating this like some sort of phase and that...you don’t {i}actually{/i} like me at all.
lines.zh: : 除非你把这当成某种阶段，而且……你{i}其实{/i}根本不喜欢我。

lines.en: : You want to save the cutting thing for later? Fine.
lines.zh: : 你想把自残那件事留到以后再说？行。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t treat this like a phase, Rin.
lines.zh: : 我不会把这当成什么阶段，Rin。

lines.en: : I might be an asshole, but I'm not {i}that{/i} much of an asshole.
lines.zh: : 我也许是个混蛋，但还没混蛋到{i}那种{/i}程度。

lines.en: : Good. Because this definitely isn’t a phase for me, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 那就好。因为这对我来说绝对不是什么阶段，Otoha。

lines.en: : I like girls. I like {i}you.{/i} And yeah, there are people out there who think that’s disgusting or wrong or sinful or...do you think I haven’t heard all of that before?
lines.zh: : 我喜欢女生。我喜欢{i}你{/i}。是啊，外面是有人觉得这恶心、不对、是罪过，或者……你以为这些话我没听过吗？

lines.en: : I’m not even fully out yet because I can understand all of that. There are still plenty of people who don’t know that I’m bisexual.
lines.zh: : 我甚至还没有完全出柜，因为那些我都能理解。还有很多人不知道我是双性恋。

lines.en: : Rin, everyone knows you’re bisexual. You’re horrible at hiding it. But they don’t look at you any differently.
lines.zh: : Rin，所有人都知道你是双性恋。你藏得烂透了。可他们看你的眼神并没有任何不同。

lines.en: : In fact, {i}who{/i} do you care about that has looked at you differently for this?
lines.zh: : 说真的，你在乎的人里，有{i}谁{/i}因为这个用不一样的眼光看过你吗？

lines.en: : Because the two people who raised me not accepting it seems like a pretty good reason for me to be wary about just announcing it to everyone.
lines.zh: : 因为把我养大的那两个人都不接受这件事，这对我来说，已经足够成为不随便跟所有人宣告的理由了。

lines.en: scene otohadinner39
: I am {i}not{/i} a part of {i}everyone,{/i} Otoha! I am your {i}girlfriend!{/i} Whether you’re comfortable with that or not!
lines.zh: : 我{i}不是{/i}「所有人」里的一员，Otoha！我是你的{i}女朋友{/i}！不管你对这件事自在不自在！

lines.en: : I need to know about things like this!
lines.zh: : 这种事我需要知道！

lines.en: scene otohadinner40
: And {i}I{/i} need to know when you’re fucking hurting yourself, Rin!
lines.zh: : 而{i}我{/i}需要知道你什么时候在伤害自己，Rin！

lines.en: : Then pay more attention...
lines.zh: : 那你就多留心一点……

lines.en: scene otohadinner41
: You’re always working. And I respect that. I really do.
lines.zh: : 你总是在工作。这一点我尊重。真的。

lines.en: : I just figured that, since I'm someone who’s apparently so bad at hiding things...my girlfriend would have maybe caught on about something being...wrong with me.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，既然我这个人藏不住事是出了名的……我的女朋友大概会察觉到我有点……不对劲吧。

lines.en: : There’s nothing “wrong” with you. And I will {i}try{/i} to pay more attention, but I don’t want you {i}trying{/i} to hide things like that from me.
lines.zh: : 你没有任何「不对劲」。我会{i}努力{/i}多留心，但我不希望你{i}刻意{/i}把这种事瞒着我。

lines.en: scene otohadinner42
: Are {i}we{/i} even right together, Otoha?
lines.zh: : 我们{i}俩{/i}在一起到底对不对，Otoha？

lines.en: : Is {i}this{/i} right?
lines.zh: : {i}这样{/i}是对的吗？

lines.en: : Why...wouldn’t it be?
lines.zh: : 为什么……会不对呢？

lines.en: : Because you’re not comfortable being with another girl...and I’m too worried that I’ll wind up doing something that makes you think less of me.
lines.zh: : 因为你和另一个女生在一起并不自在……而我太担心自己迟早会做出什么让你看轻我的事。

lines.en: scene otohadinner43
: It’s not that I’m uncomfortable! And I’m not going to think less of you for doing something like that!
lines.zh: : 我不是不自在！我也不会因为那种事就看轻你！

lines.en: : I’m just overwhelmed, okay?!
lines.zh: : 我只是有点招架不住，行了吧？！

lines.en: : I want my parents to accept us! {i}I{/i} want to accept us! I {i}like{/i} us!
lines.zh: : 我想让我父母接受我们！{i}我{/i}自己也想接受我们！我{i}喜欢{/i}我们！

lines.en: : I just need some more time getting adjusted, that’s all!
lines.zh: : 我只是还需要一点时间适应，就这样！

lines.en: : You’ve had your whole life to deal with these feelings, haven’t you? I’ve only had a few months.
lines.zh: : 你可是用了一辈子来消化这些感情，不是吗？我才只有几个月。

lines.en: : I’ve never felt this way about {i}anyone{/i} before, let alone another girl. So yeah, I’d be lying if I said it wasn’t embarrassing.
lines.zh: : 我从来没有对{i}任何人{/i}有过这种感觉，更别说对另一个女生了。所以，我要是说这不丢人，那就是在撒谎。

lines.en: : But I don’t want to lie anymore. I want to try and make this work. But if you’re going to keep hurting yourself and not telling me about it, I-
lines.zh: : 可我不想再撒谎了。我想试着让这段关系走下去。但如果你还要继续伤害自己又不告诉我，我——

lines.en: scene otohadinner44
: I never wanted to hide it from you...
lines.zh: : 我从来没想瞒着你……

lines.en: : I was just afraid you wouldn’t like me anymore...
lines.zh: : 我只是怕你不再喜欢我了……

lines.en: : Don’t be afraid of that.
lines.zh: : 别怕这个。

lines.en: : Please.
lines.zh: : 求你了。

lines.en: scene otohadinner45
: {i}*Sniff*{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}*Sniff*{/i}

lines.en: : Are we breaking up?
lines.zh: : 我们要分手了吗？

lines.en: : Is that what you want?
lines.zh: : 那是你想要的吗？

lines.en: : {i}*Sniff*{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}*Sniff*{/i}
: 不是……

lines.en: scene otohadinner46
: Me neither.
lines.zh: : 我也不想。

lines.en: : Are you going to keep me hidden forever?
lines.zh: : 你打算把我永远藏着吗？

lines.en: : Of course not...
lines.zh: : 当然不会……

lines.en: : Just...
lines.zh: : 只是……

lines.en: : For a little while longer. While I figure things out.
lines.zh: : 再藏一小段时间。等我想清楚。

lines.en: : {i}*Sniff*{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}*Sniff*{/i}

lines.en: : Do you have any other demands, my queen?
lines.zh: : 你还有其他要求吗，我的女王大人？

lines.en: : {i}*Sniff*{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}*Sniff*{/i}

lines.en: : Can we make out?
lines.zh: : 我们能接吻吗？

lines.en: : Like...
: Like, literally right now?
lines.zh: : 就、就现在，立刻？

lines.en: : {i}*Sniff*{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}*Sniff*{/i}

lines.en: : Only if you want to...
lines.zh: : 只要你也想……

lines.en: : Sure, Rin.
lines.zh: : 当然，Rin。

lines.en: : We can make out.
lines.zh: : 我们可以接吻。

lines.en: scene otohadinner47
: Mnh~ Mm...
lines.zh: : 唔嗯~ 唔……

lines.en: : Chu...hmnn...mm...Otoha...
lines.zh: : 啾……唔嗯……唔……Otoha……

lines.en: : Mn~ Mmm...Rin...
lines.zh: : 嗯~ 唔嗯……Rin……

lines.en: scene otohadinner48
: Are you two done making u- oh.
lines.zh: : 你们俩亲完了没——哦。

lines.en: : They are making {i}out.{/i}
lines.zh: : 她们{i}正在{/i}亲。

lines.en: : They certainly are.
lines.zh: : 确实是在亲。

lines.en: : Girls are fucking exhausting. I’m glad I never dated one.
lines.zh: : 女生真是累死人。幸好我从没跟女生谈过恋爱。

lines.en: : They certainly are.
lines.zh: : 确实累。

lines.en: scene otohadinner49
: Wanna go make out in the bathroom?
lines.zh: : 想去洗手间亲热吗？

lines.en: : I certainly do.
lines.zh: : 我当然想。

lines.en: scene black
And everyone lived happily ever after...
lines.zh: 于是所有人都幸福地生活了下去……
